scope: Curated core claims and Hegel-authored counterevidence, not all archived sources or all research claims.
counting_rule: Primary-share denominator is these curated Hegel evidence entries only; it is not a claim about the entire archive. One work across languages/parts counts once for cross-work support.
limits: Literal presence verifies an archive fingerprint, not interpretation or authenticity.
Passage-level A/B/C grade overrides mixed whole-file grades.
Short needles are retrieval handles, not stand-alone quotations proving the whole paraphrase.
Some witness files include translator/editor material. Use the named locator and read context.
